opening.argument: The video presents RBC technology and wealth-management work as a recruitment opportunity: viewers are directed to “Join us – jobs.rbc.com/wmtech.” while the speaker encourages “Other technologists should work at RBC in technology.” It frames collaboration and technology as ways to “redefine what it means to be part of wealth management and what it means to serve clients in a new way,” establishing employment promotion as the purpose of the message. The audience is directed toward an RBC jobs webpage, not asked for investment, payment, credentials, or financial participation. The visual material reinforces that employment context by showing office settings together with the RBC logo and recruitment URL.
